label: The determination wisdom is a pure perfection
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the determination wisdom (read as the bearer's own subject-grounded apprehension, not productive or exemplary wisdom) is a pure perfection: an actuality that involves no potency, limitation or reception (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION). It uses the same purity parameter as 'every actual concrete root has every pure perfection', so no sense passage is involved. The Lean type is only Pure wisdom for one token; what makes that token intellectual is not its name but the separate open bridge that a subsistent bearer of it can apprehend a true content about itself.
